jobs.title: Planning & Client Compliance Consultant
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as a Planning \& Client Compliance Consultant, where you will play a vital role in ensuring project planning excellence and maintaining rigorous client compliance standards. This energetic position offers the opportunity to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, utilize cutting\-edge design and analysis tools, and contribute to impactful projects that shape communities and environments. Your expertise will drive efficient planning processes, support client relationships, and uphold regulatory and quality standards with precision and enthusiasm.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop detailed project plans using software such as SketchUp, AutoCAD, Rhinoceros 3D, Revit, and Adobe Creative Suite to visualize concepts and facilitate stakeholder understanding.
* Conduct comprehensive data analysis utilizing ArcGIS, CAD, and other GIS tools to support planning decisions and optimize project outcomes.
* Coordinate with clients and internal teams to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, project specifications, and environmental standards.
* Prepare clear, thorough reports and documentation to communicate project progress, compliance status, and technical findings.
* Oversee project timelines, budgets, and deliverables through effective project management practices while maintaining flexibility for evolving project needs.
* Assist in site assessments by integrating construction experience with technical skills to identify potential challenges early in the planning process.
* Support the creation of visual presentations and proposals that effectively convey design intent and compliance strategies to stakeholders.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in planning or design\-related roles with a strong background in construction or infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in SketchUp, AutoCAD, Rhinoceros 3D, Revit, Adobe Creative Suite, ArcGIS, and CAD software is essential.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data sets and produce comprehensive reports that inform decision\-making.
* Prior experience managing multiple projects simultaneously while adhering to deadlines is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of client compliance procedures within regulatory frameworks related to urban planning or environmental standards.
* Excellent communication skills for report writing, stakeholder engagement, and cross\-disciplinary collaboration.
* Construction experience is a plus, providing practical insights into the feasibility of design proposals.

Embark on a rewarding career where your technical expertise fuels innovative projects that make a difference! We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values your skills and enthusiasm as we work together toward sustainable development solutions.

Pay: £42,000\.00\-£58,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Company events
* Gym membership
* Health \& wellbeing programme

Work Location: In person
